text:
Shares of Anthropic are now trading on the NASDAQ exchange, as the company successfully executes its initial public offering. In the early minutes of availability, shares were trading at $110, a 33% premium over the $83 IPO price.
Set on Wednesday, the IPO price was already above higher than the projected range set by the company, which anticipated a price between $70 and $78 per share.
That IPO, together with existing fundraising and new private offerings timed to coincide with the company’s public market debut, will leave Anthropic with an expected $220 billion in cash reserves. As one analyst told TechCrunch, “Anthropic’s going to have more cash on hand than any company has ever had.”
